title: knowledge(data-modeling): TableRelation delete/rename asymmetry and the xRec before-image contract
summary: Three data-modeling knowledge articles with executable tests clarify cascading delete behavior, TableRelation validation effects on rename propagation, and xRec before-image availability across different triggers.
key_points: Owning tables must delete dependent records manually since AL lacks cascading delete, and delete permissions are required on dependent tables
Setting ValidateTableRelation to false suppresses rename propagation, not just input validation
xRec is a true before-image only in OnRename and OnDelete, or in OnInsert/OnModify when triggered from a page, but reflects current Rec when those triggers fire from code
